name: pole_angle_agreement
summary: pole_angle: worst second_largest absolute error 5.537e-01 rad exceeds 2.880e-02 rad; first violation at step 6

tolerance.rationale: The baseline pole crosses 1.0 rad at a measured median rate of 3.456 rad/s. At 120 Hz, the local one-period angular displacement is 3.456 rad/s / 120 Hz = 0.0288 rad. This engineering budget corresponds to one control period near that crossing. It does not guarantee that a sub-budget difference cannot change the sampled crossing index; the event oracle checks timing directly.
tolerance.scope: per-step absolute pole-angle error, reduced over environments

name: pole_velocity_agreement
summary: pole_velocity: worst second_largest absolute error 1.471e+00 rad/s exceeds 9.095e-02 rad/s; first violation at step 0

tolerance.rationale:
Capture index 0 is the first post-reset step. The baseline median threshold index is 37, so median elapsed time is 38 / 120 = 0.3166667 s. Requiring a sustained pole-rate difference to accumulate no more than the 0.0288 rad angle budget over that measured median time gives 0.0288 rad / 0.3166667 s = 0.0909474 rad/s.
This oracle exists because of what it observes, not only what it gates: a reset that drops velocity leaves position identical at step 0 and only diverges through integration, so a position-only manifest sees a smooth growing error and classifies it as drift. Watching the velocity is what makes the step-0 signature visible and the divergence classifiable.
tolerance.scope: per-step absolute pole angular-rate error, reduced over environments

divergence.limitations: Timing deltas grow naturally with horizon in chaotic regimes; this oracle is informative only over horizons where the baseline timing is stable.
